title: hotfix: SLO enforcer CB fallback causes regional over-shedding under burst load
author: Priya Sharma
release_notes: Hotfix: Fix SLO enforcer fallback ordering that triggered regional over-shedding during short bursts. Improves stability and reduces false-positive load-shedding events. Backported to stable release branch.
description:
Summary: This hotfix addresses a regression in the SLO enforcer introduced by a fallback ordering change that caused excessive load-shedding in secondary regions during short burst traffic. Under certain timing windows the circuit-breaker fallback path triggered before the regional failover decision was reconciled, which caused simultaneous shedding across regions and violated local SLOs.

Root cause: A recent change (ENG-2146) inverted the order of fallback evaluation in slo/enforcer/fallback_policy.go to prefer model-variant fallbacks earlier. In production this exposed a race between circuit-breaker tripping and region selection when ephemeral capacity pressure occurred. The enforcer would mark a region as "overloaded" then immediately apply global shedding rules, preventing the regional failover controller from attempting localized retries.

What I changed: 1) Reordered fallback evaluation to ensure regional failover decisions are made before global CB fallback is applied; 2) Added a short hysteresis window (200ms by default, configurable) to avoid flip-flop during burst spikes; 3) Tightened the CB-to-shedding handoff to only apply shedding when region-level decisions report steady-state overload for at least two consecutive evaluation ticks; 4) Added unit and integration tests that simulate rapid bursts across two regions and assert only the overloaded region sheds.

Files touched: slo/enforcer/circuit_breaker.go, slo/enforcer/fallback_policy.go, slo/enforcer/hysteresis.go, slo/enforcer/README.md, integration-tests/slo/regional_failover_burst_test.go, telemetry/metrics_registry.go, config/defaults.yaml, deploy/patches/stable-hotfix.yaml.

Testing: Unit tests added and existing enforcer unit tests updated. Integration test harness recreates a two-region cluster and injects 5s bursts at t=0 and t=10s to verify behavior. On CI the integration test flaked initially (timing sensitivity) - I added deterministic clocks in the test harness to avoid nondeterminism. CI: unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (rerun -> pass), linters (pass), e2e-staging (pass).

Rollout plan: Merge to main and backport with a patch release to the stable branch. Canary rollout to 10% of traffic in secondary region for 2 hours, monitor SLO enforcer metrics (slo.enforcer.shed_rate, slo.enforcer.cb_trips, slo.enforcer.failover_attempts) and tracing on region-selection path. Immediate rollback if shed_rate increases > 2x baseline or errors > 0.5%.

Checklist: - [x] Reproduce failure locally and in staging harness - [x] Add unit + integration tests - [x] CI green (all checks passed) - [x] Add observability metrics and dashboards for the change - [x] Add default hysteresis config (conservative) - [x] Prepare stable branch patch (deploy/patches/stable-hotfix.yaml)

Related: ENG-2146 (original change), ENG-2201 (follow-up stability work), SUP-4312 (customer incident ticket).
